text:
morgan: Heads-up — coordinated version bumps for the upcoming cut. Targeting:
- API -> v2.3.0
- runtime -> v1.9.2
- console -> v0.12.0
- SDKs -> v3.0.0 (js/py/go)
Cutoff: Fri 18:00 PT. Please ack and call out blockers.

dev-release-bot: Reminder created: release/cutoff/1770456789, will ping again 24h and 2h before cutoff. :bell:

li: ack. I'll prep API CHANGELOG + open the release PRs (branch: release/v2.3.0). Will also pin runtime dep in api repo.

karan: note — runtime v1.9.2 includes the kv-cache API rename (kv.get -> kv.fetch). It's a lightweight breaking change. I'll add a compat shim and flag, aiming to have PR up by EOD Thu.

tess: console PR is in flight (#412). Needs the SDK route rename to land first. I can hold console CI until SDK PRs merge.

sham: which SDKs exactly? SDK-js and SDK-py are high priority; go can be bumped after JS/PY ship unless console e2e requires it.

morgan: all three. CI jobs to watch: `sdk-js-release`, `sdk-py-release`, `sdk-go-release`. Also watch `canary-smoke` for console.

li: small ask — include a migration note in the API changelog about the kv-cache rename and add a snippet for quick fix:```bash
# client fix example
client.kv.fetch(key)  # replace client.kv.get(key)
```

karan: q: do we need to update model catalog entries pinned by API (some endpoints reference default-models)? If yes I'll coordinate with research.

morgan: yes — if API surface changes, update the model catalog and the docs. Tag @research in your PRs.

dev-release-bot: 24h reminder scheduled for 1770543189. Checklist created: [changelogs, cross-repo PR links, rollout policy, canary run].

tess: noted. I'll add console changelog + a single canary e2e test to catch route regressions.

sham: question — do we want staged rollout for runtime? Dedicated customers on reserved pools probably shouldn't auto-upgrade same day.

morgan: yes — plan: canary 10% for 24h, 100% for hosted after smoke pass. Dedicated tenants: hold on previous runtime for 72h unless they opt-in. I'll add that to the release notes.

karan: adding a runtime feature flag `kv_compat_mode` default true for 72h for dedicated upgrades, then false. Will add migration toggle in runtime config.

li: I'll open the API changelog PRs and create a meta-PR that links all cross-repo bumps (api/runtime/console/sdk-js/sdk-py/sdk-go) so release engineer can merge in one sequence.

morgan: perfect. Please post PR links here when ready. If we have no major blockers by Thu EOD, I will lock the release branch and post the final cutoff reminder. :thumbsup:

sham: small nit — can we include the release checklist snippet in the meta-PR description? Saves release engineer time.

morgan: yes do that. Suggested checklist in meta-PR description:
- [ ] API changelog updated
- [ ] runtime compat shim PR
- [ ] console PR (#412)
- [ ] sdk-js, sdk-py, sdk-go release PRs
- [ ] canary smoke green (`canary-smoke` job)
- [ ] rollout policy applied for dedicated tenants

li: PRs opened: api#2785, sdk-js#530, sdk-py#222. Will paste links.

karan: runtime PR up: runtime#989 (compat shim + `kv_compat_mode`). Adding tests now.

tess: console PR updated with the sdk-js change. Will queue e2e.

morgan: great — this is looking good. If anyone spots a blocker, drop it here asap. Otherwise expect merge sequence Fri morning, cut at Fri 18:00 PT.

sham: ack — will coordinate release jobs and watch canary results.

li: ack.

karan: ack.

_timeline note: initial message 1770456789, last reply 1770457840_
